nodes.summary: A group $G$ is locally finite when for every finite subset $S$ of $G$ the subgroup generated by $S$ is finite, that is, every finitely generated subgroup of $G$ is finite.
nodes.title: Locally finite group

nodes.summary: For a subset $X$ of a group $G$, write $C_G(X)$ for the centralizer of $X$ in $G$. The group $G$ satisfies the minimal condition on centralizers when there is no sequence of subsets $X_0, X_1, X_2, \ldots$ of $G$ whose centralizers form a strictly descending chain $C_G(X_0) > C_G(X_1) > C_G(X_2) > \cdots$, where $H > K$ means that $K$ is a proper subgroup of $H$.
nodes.title: Minimal condition on centralizers

nodes.summary: Every group $G$ in which every element has order a power of $2$ and which satisfies the minimal condition on centralizers is locally finite.
nodes.title: Every $2$-group with the minimal condition on centralizers is locally finite (Kourovka 11.103)

nodes.summary: Wilson's question on $2$-groups with the minimal condition on centralizers (Kourovka problem 11.103). The statement that every group $G$ in which every element has order a power of $2$ and which satisfies the minimal condition on centralizers is locally finite.
nodes.title: Wilson's question on $2$-groups with the minimal condition on centralizers (Kourovka problem 11.103)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
